evidence.detail: Exact v308 builds root widget 60200 and preserves the literal title '@or1@Donation Shopping Cart'.
The class owns exact subtotal/checkout/purchase-option text including '@or1@Subtotal: @yel@$0.00', 'Checkout', 'Checkout @yel@($0.00)', 'Purchase Options' and Shopping Cart resources.
R128 already proves ScriptPacket ID 36 is registered from rs/n/c/aw.d; its concrete handler updates the Donation Shopping Cart particle/progress presentation graph rooted by this interface.
The class is constructed by the central interface registry and builds the complete 600xx/602xx cart widget tree; it has no unrelated service responsibility.

proposals.note: Exact-v308 self-identifying interface name completing the ScriptPacket-36 donation-shopping-cart subsystem.
